title: The tilde control case in test_guard pins the variable read
why: The control `R="~/tilde~dir"` (hooks/test_guard.py about 8417) denies because the folder is missing, not because the variable is unknown, so dropping either tilde arm in guard_core.py survives. Fix: point HOME at a real checkout folder in the control, and add `R=a:~/x` for the `:~` arm. Found by #2379 fix check (reviewer sonnet, 2026-11-11 07:39 CST). Test-only lane, after #2379 lands.
